Rejected hypothesis: The response writer or JSON serialization was not the mutation source; the focused failure shows the sentinel itself changed immediately after handler execution.
Verified invariant: Explicit response defaults and JSON status behavior remain observable, while the new regression fails because the original sentinel becomes status 500 with default type and title.
Untested invariant: Explicit fields, exposed detail, content type, HEAD/no-content behavior, and concurrent reuse still require verification after the production fix.
Unresolved gap: Decide the smallest response-local copy strategy that preserves all caller-provided fields without mutating either direct or ProblemErrorer-returned problems.
Graph question: Which handler construction and response-writing paths consume the problem pointer, and can a shallow response-local copy preserve their current semantics?
